lead.headline: TANKERS BURN IN HORMUZ AS IRAN TIGHTENS THE STRAIT
lead.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say four tankers struck naval mines and caught fire, and say they attacked a container ship that switched off its tracking. Tehran orders the strait closed 'further' day by day until Washington meets its terms. Maritime monitors say the mine claims are unconfirmed.

second_leads.headline: Huawei guilty of trade-secret theft and bank fraud
second_leads.summary: A US jury convicts Huawei on 10 of 12 counts, including conspiracy to violate sanctions; it acquits the firm of racketeering. Sentencing is set for September 2027; Huawei says it will appeal.

second_leads.headline: Senegal get their Africa Cup back
second_leads.summary: Sports court CAS restores Senegal's 1–0 extra-time AFCON final win over Morocco, overturning CAF's 3–0 forfeit ruling after the walk-off protest. Morocco vows to appeal.

stories.headline: Tankers burn in Hormuz as Iran tightens the strait
stories.source: Daily Summary Of, 24 Nov 2026 (30 stories, 64 sources)
stories.summary: IRGC says four tankers hit naval mines and caught fire and it attacked a container ship; Iran orders the strait closed further day by day; maritime monitors say the mine claims are unconfirmed.

stories.headline: Huawei guilty of trade-secret theft and bank fraud
stories.source: Daily Summary Of; Economic Times live blog, 24 Nov 2026
stories.summary: US jury in Brooklyn convicts Huawei on 10 of 12 counts, including sanctions conspiracy; acquitted of racketeering; sentencing September 2027.

stories.headline: Senegal get their Africa Cup back
stories.summary: CAS upholds Senegal's appeal, restoring the 1-0 extra-time AFCON final win over Morocco and overturning CAF's 3-0 forfeit ruling.

stories.headline: Trump orders DOJ to expedite federal executions
stories.summary: Trump signs a directive seeking the death penalty for child murders, rapists and traffickers who kill, and attacks Newsom over commuting 548 death-row sentences.

stories.headline: Appeals court revives Trump's hush-money transfer bid
stories.summary: 2nd Circuit reverses a lower court, reopening Trump's bid to move his New York hush-money case to federal court and argue presidential immunity.

stories.headline: Trump to meet El-Sayed on 'Medicare for All' as 'Trumpcare'
stories.summary: Trump says he will meet Michigan Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed to discuss his universal healthcare proposal, which El-Sayed pitched rebranding after Trump.

stories.headline: Pentagon rebukes Canada over defence shortfalls
stories.summary: Pentagon fact sheet says only 41.9% of Canada's air force fleet was serviceable in 2025-26 and criticises Ottawa's review of its planned 88 F-35s.

stories.headline: US blacklists Megaspeed at centre of Nvidia spy scandal
stories.source: Daily Summary Of; Just Security Early Edition, 24 Nov 2026
stories.summary: Commerce Dept places Singapore-based Megaspeed International and six other Southeast Asian firms on the Entity List, requiring licences for advanced US tech.

stories.headline: Nvidia slides as Huang rally fades; Dow tops 50,000
stories.source: Economic Times live blog; OneTurn, 24 Nov 2026
stories.summary: Nvidia falls about 6-7% a day after Huang's return; Nasdaq -1.45%, S&P 500 -0.48%, Dow +0.87% to 50,028.79; Bitcoin slips below $60,000.

stories.headline: US soldier admits selling military secrets to China
stories.summary: US soldier Jian Zhao admits selling military information to Chinese buyers.

stories.headline: Gunmen hold 25 hostages in Cartagena supermarket
stories.summary: Armed men seize a supermarket in Cartagena after a failed armoured-car raid; five older women released, military and police deployed.

stories.headline: Car bomb in Villavicencio injures 23
stories.source: Daily Summary Of; Al Jazeera, 24 Nov 2026
stories.summary: Car bomb outside regional government offices in Villavicencio, Colombia; president blames narcoterrorism on the eve of the FARC peace deal's 10th anniversary.

stories.headline: Brazil cuts 2027 growth forecast to 1.8%
stories.summary: Brazil cuts its 2027 growth forecast to 1.8% and raises its inflation forecast.

stories.headline: WHO chief visits Cuba, pledges $2m for vaccinations
stories.source: Al Jazeera Latin America; Breitbart, 24 Nov 2026
stories.summary: WHO Director-General Tedros visits Cuba and pledges $2m for its national vaccination program as the healthcare system deteriorates.

stories.headline: Supercell storm devastates Tupanciretã, Brazil
stories.summary: A powerful supercell storm devastates the Brazilian town of Tupanciretã, displacing thousands.

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV hit by flying rosary in Peru
stories.source: Sumi.news South America feed; Breitbart, 24 Nov 2026
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV is hit in the face by a rosary thrown from a crowd in Peru and jokes about it on his Latin America tour.

stories.headline: Brazil's U-17s fall to Tanzania at U-17 World Cup
stories.summary: Tanzania beat Brazil in the Under-17 World Cup group stage.

stories.headline: COP31 fallout: focus shifts to COP32 in Addis Ababa
stories.summary: COP31 closed without a deal, the first failure since Copenhagen 2009; a just-transition package and electrification pledges survived; COP32 goes to Addis Ababa.

stories.headline: Putin: retaliation 'inevitable' after Ukraine hit oil plants
stories.summary: Putin says Ukraine keeps striking refineries despite Trump's plea; Ukrainian strikes have cut Russian refining by about 45% since late October.

stories.headline: Poland accuses Russia of deliberate airspace violation
stories.summary: Poland says a Russian surveillance drone deliberately entered its airspace during an attack on western Ukraine; three Kh-101 missiles landed in Poland on Friday.

stories.headline: Spain polls: PP + Vox on track for majority
stories.summary: Polls by Ipsos, Data10, GAD3 and Hamalgama Métrica put the PP ahead before the 29 November snap election, with a right-wing coalition set for a majority.

stories.headline: UK police arrest 2 after break-in at Prince William's home
stories.summary: Two masked men arrested after a break-in at Anmer Hall on the Sandringham estate; the Prince and Princess of Wales were not at home.

stories.headline: NATO vows defence against space threat
stories.summary: NATO chief Mark Rutte says the alliance will defend against threats in space after reports Russia may launch a nuclear-armed satellite within 60 days.

stories.headline: Merz: not admitting Ukraine to NATO in 2008 was a 'mistake'
stories.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says the Russian invasion would likely not have happened if allies had agreed to admit Kyiv in 2008.

stories.headline: DR Congo fighting traps Ebola responders
stories.summary: Heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province traps WHO staff and Ebola responders for over 24 hours; outbreak cases pass 11,000.

stories.headline: DR Congo searches for missing cargo plane
stories.summary: DRC loses contact with a Cessna 208 cargo plane in poor weather; rebels say they shot down a similar aircraft near Minembwe, with four aboard.

stories.headline: Sudan: WFP chief warns funding cuts deepen hunger
stories.summary: WFP's new executive director warns funding cuts are worsening Sudan's hunger crisis after his first field mission; aid is the 'only hope' for millions.

stories.headline: Libya's Haftar visits Turkey for first time
stories.summary: Libyan commander Khalifa Haftar visits Ankara at Turkey's invitation and is expected to meet President Erdogan; eastern parliament approved a maritime deal with Turkey last month.

stories.headline: South Sudan's first elections loom amid violence
stories.summary: With South Sudan six weeks from its first national elections since independence, the Security Council meets amid deepening political uncertainty and worsening violence.

stories.headline: MSF suspends work in South Sudan's Yei River county
stories.summary: Médecins Sans Frontières suspends all activities for at least three months after an abduction in Yei River county.

stories.headline: ANC and ActionSA carve up Joburg posts
stories.summary: ANC and ActionSA carve up key Johannesburg positions in a potential 18-party coalition after local elections.

stories.headline: ICJ finds Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice rules 9-6 that Myanmar's security forces committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017 — the first time the UN's highest court found a state responsible for genocide.

stories.headline: Saudi PIF tower hit in suspected Houthi drone attack
stories.summary: A Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District wounds at least 11; the PIF headquarters building is hit for the second time in under a week.

stories.headline: Israel kills Hamas security chief in Gaza strike
stories.summary: Israeli air strikes kill Hamas internal security chief Naeem Abu Nahel and six others in Gaza, despite a ceasefire in place since October 2025.

stories.headline: Gaza meningitis epidemic alert
stories.summary: Gaza's health ministry issues an epidemic alert after 272 meningitis infections in October, more than eight times the normal monthly rate; 15 have died this year.

stories.headline: Saudi strikes on Yemen buses and trucks kill 25
stories.summary: Saudi aircraft strike buses and trucks in Wadi Maabaq, Lahj governorate, leaving 25 dead or missing and six wounded, Saba news agency reports.

stories.headline: Hanoi restaurant blast kills six
stories.summary: An explosion at a hot pot restaurant in Hanoi's Dong Da district kills at least six and injures at least 10; authorities suspect a cooking gas leak.

stories.headline: China sentences official to death for spying
stories.summary: A Chinese official surnamed Ma is sentenced to death for spying for an unnamed foreign country, having provided 35 classified items and received over 1 million yuan.

stories.headline: Champions League: Real Madrid rout PSV 5-1
stories.summary: Real Madrid beat PSV 5-1; Manchester City draw 2-2 with Napoli; Arsenal draw 1-1 with Borussia Dortmund in Champions League league phase, matchday 5.

stories.headline: India beat China 6-2 in Women's Asian Champions Trophy
stories.summary: India beat China 6-2 in Bhopal for their fourth straight win in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy hockey tournament.

stories.headline: Pakistani astronaut set for historic Tiangong flight
stories.summary: Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is on course to be the first non-Chinese national to ride a Chinese crewed craft and visit the Tiangong station.

stories.headline: 5,000 drones light up sky over Three Gorges
stories.summary: 5,000 drones illuminate the sky over the Three Gorges at an autumn festival in China.

stories.headline: Fiji suffer record 15-0 loss to Spain at U-17 World Cup
stories.summary: Fiji lose 15-0 to Spain in their second match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Qatar, the heaviest loss in the country's history at the competition.

stories.headline: Solomon Cup: Western Tomoko hammer Isabel Frigates 5-0
stories.summary: Western Tomoko beat Isabel Frigates 5-0 in the Solomon Cup at Lawson Tama Stadium, Honiara, moving to six points from two matches.

stories.headline: New Zealand held by Vietnam at U-17 World Cup
stories.summary: New Zealand draw with Vietnam at the U-17 World Cup, leaving them bottom of Group G with one point from two matches but hopes of progressing alive.
